notes.title: Update Notes v1.15
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that caused gibberish-looking text in Japanese.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.14
notes.content:
- Mod support expanded: add your own space backgrounds, stations, planets, moons, and music by placing files in the corresponding folders inside the mod directory using your file manager.

- Still investigating a bug where player ships continue firing at the location of destroyed enemy ships. I’ve made a change in the code that might fix it. If the issue persists, please let me know what actions trigger it and any patterns you notice.

- Fixed a bug that prevented the next sector from loading even after all player ships had entered the wormhole.

- Various bug fixes and improvements related to Mods and the Ship Builder.

- Fixed a bug that caused all station sprites to appear the same.

- Increased thrust values for Engine levels 2 and 3.

- Minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.13
notes.content: [p]I’ve always planned to add limited mod support to the game, and with this update, it’s finally here! To ensure stability and avoid major bugs, the first release of modding focuses only on the Ship Builder. More modding features will be added in future updates.[/p][p][b]New in this version:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Mod support introduced[/b] – starting with Ship Builder.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Workshop integration[/b] for easy sharing and downloading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Titan Ship Rewards Rebalanced[/b] – Titan ships are no longer free; instead, you’ll earn credit rewards for completing story missions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various bug fixes and improvements.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, I’d love to hear from you![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136380/Space_Menace_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes v0.49
notes.content:
- Improved balancing for non-player ships: Their strength now scales with the player's power. Sectors will start with more enemy ships, reinforcements will arrive more quickly, and non-player ships will be equipped with more modules. They will also prioritize targeting the player's capital ships over smaller craft.

- UI scaling fixes: Resolved layout issues that occurred when the player changed the UI scale.

- Minor bug fixes and changes

notes.title: Update Notes v0.48
notes.content:
- Fixed bugs related to fighter
- Resolved issues affecting the tutorial
- Adjusted solar flare mechanics so stations are no longer affected
- Minor bug fixes and changes

notes.title: Update Notes v0.47
notes.content:
🪐 New Sector Environments
Three new environments have been added to sectors, introducing fresh challenges and tactical depth. Feedback is welcome — whether these additions improve the experience or feel frustrating.
[list]
[*]Asteroid Storm
Sectors affected by this environment contain fast-moving asteroids that damage ships on impact.

[*]Nebula Cloud
Dense gas and dust interfere with sensors, reducing weapon range and encouraging close range combat.

[*]Solar Flare
Unpredictable solar flares from nearby stars cause periodic area damage. Timing and positioning become essential.
[/list]
🔧 Fixes & Improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to renaming ship.
[*] Various bug fixes and changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.45
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.44
notes.content:
- New left-click behavior option for player ships. Choose between two control styles:
  -- RTS-style: Always select the clicked ship and deselect all others.
  -- Toggle-style: Select or deselect the clicked ship without changing other selections.

- Mission locations now visible directly on mission pages, no need to click "Show on Map" anymore.

- Module stat rework: Higher-level modules now offer more rewarding stat progression.

- NPC upgrades: NPC ships now come equipped with more modules, making them slightly stronger.

- Minor bug fixes and changes.

notes.title: Announcing Space Menace 2 | Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tl1KC2JHnnY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi there everyone,
I'm thrilled to announce my upcoming sci-fi space RTS and battle game, Space Menace 2, now available to wishlist! A heartfelt thank you to all the players of the original Space Menace—your invaluable feedback made this sequel possible.

Space Menace 2 thrusts you into a galaxy on the brink of chaos, where every decision you make shapes the future of the stars. As a space captain, you’ll start with a small, modest fleet, but your journey is anything but ordinary. With the freedom to chart your own course, you'll engage in freelance missions, trade, and battles, earning the credits needed to expand and upgrade your fleet.

[h3]Rise to Power[/h3]
As you rise through the ranks, the stakes grow higher. Initially commanding just a few ships, you'll soon find yourself in control of powerful fleets, gaining the trust and respect of the galaxy's most formidable factions. Align yourself wisely, for your reputation will grant you unprecedented power, from commanding faction fleets to eventually leading entire factions as their supreme leader.

[h3]Customize[/h3]
Customization is key in Space Menace 2. Tailor your fleet with deep loadouts, selecting from a wide array of weapons, utilities, and strike craft to create the perfect combination for your strategic needs. And with mod support, the game allows you to personalize your experience even further, adding new layers of content and possibilities.

[h3]Maximum Excitement, Minimal Grind[/h3]
Space Menace 2 is designed for maximum excitement with minimal grind, offering a deep, strategic experience that evolves as you do. As the game unfolds, so do the challenges and complexities, ensuring every moment is filled with tactical decisions and thrilling encounters. Whether you're outmaneuvering enemy fleets or negotiating with powerful allies, your choices will echo through the galaxy, leaving a legacy that only you can forge.

Wishlist Space Menace 2 now on Steam!
